title: Chapter 171 Not Very Convenient
content:
Chapter 171 Not Very Convenient

Everyone was very excited when they saw the city lord Lu Daosheng.

But when everyone felt someone rushing, they frowned.

"Why are you old guy so unqualified? You want to see the city lord, but you don't know how to queue up!"

A young man finally saw the city lord and found someone behind him and said angrily.

However, the old man did not have any regrets, but was furious.

"You little brat, I am your ancestor!"

"Huh? You actually dare to scold me?!"

The boy looked angry and rolled up his sleeves and was about to fuck him, and at this time, a wide slap fell on the back of his head.

Bang!

The sound is crisp.

juvenile:

"You rebellious son, dare to fight your ancestors!"

"Ah? Dad, he,"

The middle-aged man ignored the boy and looked at the old man with a smirk.

"Old ancestor, don't be angry. When I go back, I will definitely teach him a good lesson."

The old man snorted lightly and did not stop.

At this time, everyone saw clearly the identity of the old man, and he was the ancestor of the Li family, one of the three major families.

Suddenly, everyone hurriedly walked around a road.

The old man waved his sleeves and walked in directly.

When he was in place, the middle-aged man slapped the young man again, "Hmph, you rebellious, hurry up and go back to face the wall and think about your mistakes!"

Hearing this, the boy had a hint of grievance on his face.

"Dad, I still want to see the city lord."

"Um?"

"Uh, forget it, I don't really want to see it."

Seeing the boy compromise, the middle-aged man put away his artifact-level slippers.

"Mr. Lord, I haven't seen you for many years, and I finally saw you again!"

The old leader of the Li family came to Lu Daosheng and burst into tears.

When he saw the visitor, Lu Daosheng stepped forward to help him.

"Old Li, I haven't seen each other for many years."

After many years, Lao Li of the Li family in the deserted city has become an ancestor-level figure in the family with the crazy development of his family.

And at this time, two other old voices sounded.

"Master Lord, we are there."

Lao Zhang and Lao Liu slowly walked out of the crowd and came to Lu Daosheng.

On weekdays, young people at the bottom of the three major families may be constantly in conflict, but the top leaders of the three major families are extremely united.

Especially the three old guys.

Since retirement, the three of them have been very idle. On weekdays, they either drink tea, play chess, fish, or get together to talk about the past. Life is rich and colorful.

Looking at the three of them, Lu Daosheng also recalled his appearance when he first came to the deserted city.

At that time, the deserted city was still a remote and simple small town, but it was only bigger than some villages.

And people are also very simple.

After Lu Daosheng came to Huangcheng, he received warm welcome and help from the residents of Huangcheng.

Until many years later, Lu Daosheng made a breakthrough in his cultivation and made contributions to the Huangcheng City. Later, the old city lord died, and Lu Daosheng succeeded as the new Huangcheng City lord.

But Lu Daosheng never forgot the help of the people in Huangcheng.

This is also the reason why the indigenous people in the deserted city are treated very well in the deserted city today.

"When you have time, drink together."

Thousands of words in my heart turned into this short sentence.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, the three old guys burst into tears.

"My Lord, one word is certain."

Lu Daosheng patted the three elders and then slowly walked towards the city lord's mansion.

There, his wife and daughter are waiting for him.

"father!"

From afar, Lu Daosheng saw Lu Xue standing in front of the door and recruiting him.

And beside him is Yan Lingyun.

Lu Daosheng showed a happy smile, and then his steps accelerated, and in two steps he came to the two women.

"Xiaoxue, spiritual charm."

"Daosheng."

A small separation is better than a newlywed.

When the two met, they immediately began to feel affectionate.

On the side, Lu Xue's smile instantly froze.

Haha, parents are true love, you are just an accident?

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue sighed and then said softly: "Well, I have something to do, let's go and do it first."

"Okay, go."

Lu Daosheng chuckled.

Hearing his father's perfunctory voice, Lu Xue sighed again and left here immediately.

"Spiritual, we,"

Lu Daosheng was about to speak, but Yan Lingyun directly blocked Lu Daosheng's mouth.

"Don't talk."

Immediately, Yan Lingyun pulled Lu Daosheng directly and walked into the house.

.........

At the same time, outside the deserted city.

A team of people appeared in the void in a mighty way.

Suddenly, countless bystanders looked horrified.

This force is quite explosive anywhere.

"Is this the deserted city?"

Jian Xin and others who came to the deserted city for the first time looked at the vast city in front of them, and immediately felt a lot of emotion.

At the same time, they also understood why there were constant experts in Huangcheng.

In this environment, the problem is to remain strong.

Mu Yu was also shocked.

"Gu Chen, have you always lived here?"

Along the way, Mu Yu talked with Gu Chen for a long time and was already familiar with him.

Upon hearing this, Gu Chen shook his head and said, "No, we started out in a very small world, and we walked here step by step with the city lord."

"If I hadn't been the city lord, I wouldn't be who I am now."

Hearing this, Mu Yu became even more curious about the mayor of the deserted city.

What kind of person is the other party?

"Let's go in."

At this time, A Wei suddenly spoke.

Everyone nodded and headed towards the entrance of the deserted city.

At this time, two desert guards were guarding the gate.

"Meet the leader, all the lords."

The two desert guards hurriedly saluted respectfully.

A Wei nodded and then entered the deserted city.

With a flash of light in front of them, the scene in the deserted city suddenly appeared in everyone's eyes.

Hiss~

Suddenly, the sound of sucking in cold air sounded from the mouths of the people of the Divine Dynasty.

They never thought that the entire deserted city was made of divine crystal stones.

No wonder the divine light bloomed.

This is too heroic.

At this time, a beautiful figure appeared in front of everyone.

"I've been waiting for you for a long time."

Lu Xue looked at everyone and said with a smile.

A figure rushed out directly.

"Woo woo woo, young lady, I miss you so much!"

Ao Qing turned into a little dragon and directly wrapped around Lu Xue's arm, tears streaming down his face.

Lu Xue stroked Ao Qing and comforted him: "Okay, okay, just come back."

Looking at Ao Qing turning into a licking dragon, everyone looked disdainful.

But deep in their eyes, there was still a touch of envy.

Apart from Ao Qing, there was no one else who could be so close to the daughter of the city lord.

Once, Ouyang Yanqing was also with Lu Xue, and now, with the passage of time, he also has his own job.

Unlike Ao Qing, except for following Lu Xue closely, eating and sleeping, there is basically nothing else to do.

"Hello, young lady (Princess)."

Everyone hurriedly saluted.

"Young lady, is the city lord back?"

Awei stepped forward and asked.

Hearing this, Lu Xue smiled and said: "I am back, but if you want to see my father now, it may be a little inconvenient."
